title: Introduce stream-adapter registry and pluggable token providers; cross-SDK ergonomic wrappers and version bumps
author: Aisha Khan
description: This PR introduces a language-agnostic stream-adapter registry and a pluggable token-provider abstraction to the SDK surface so that each SDK (Python/TypeScript/Go) can opt into a shared streaming handshake and reauth strategy without shipping duplicate logic. Motivation: persistent differences in stream handshake timing and token refresh semantics across SDKs were causing duplicate reauth attempts and subtle backpressure mismatches in production. The change packages three coordinated pieces: 1) a lightweight StreamAdapterRegistry in the core redwood library that maps protocol variants to SDK adapters; 2) a PluggableTokenProvider interface plus a default refresh provider used by hosted and dedicated customers; 3) thin ergonomic wrappers added to each SDK exposing the provider as an opt-in parameter and a compatibility shim for older code paths. Checklist: - [x] Core registry implementation and protocol contract - [x] Default token provider implementation and short-circuit for static tokens - [x] SDK wrappers: python client convenience function, TS builder option, Go functional option - [x] Cross-SDK integration tests for resume/reconnect and single-token refresh paths - [x] Documentation snippets and migration notes - [x] Version bumps for SDK packages (python/ts/go) Compatibility notes: the adapters are opt-in by default; existing call sites continue to work. To enable the new behavior set `stream_adapter: "registry-v1"` and pass `token_provider` in the client constructor. There is an opt-in migration guide in docs/sdk-migration/stream-adapter.md. Rollout plan: merge to main, cut a patch release for hosted clients who opt-in, coordinate SDK releases in the same week to avoid partial parity. Related work: ENG-4026 (streaming-reconnect stability), ENG-4041 (sdk-auth-resilience).

release_notes: Added a stream-adapter registry and pluggable token providers. SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) now accept an optional token_provider for streaming calls to control refresh lifecycle. Opt-in by default. Bugfix: prevents duplicate token refresh during stream reconnects. SDK version bumps: python 1.9.0, typescript 2.4.0, go v0.9.0.
